courses.summary: 普魯德霍灣位於阿拉斯加北坡，公開許可資料記錄中央電站；寒地物流與共用能源是本課主線。本課依序分析中央供電損失、低溫物流熱量帳、季節性維修等待、液體物性與管損、水資源循環邊界，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Prudhoe Bay lies on Alaska’s North Slope, with a documented central power station; cold-region logistics and shared energy frame this case. The course analyses central electrical-supply loss, thermal account for cold-region streams, seasonal maintenance waiting, liquid properties and line friction, water-recycle boundary, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
